youtube_description:
Demi Lovato has slammed her "gross" exes while revealing plans to get married to her new boyfriend after admitting to struggling with daddy issues.

Demi said: “I went through a phase where I was attracted to older guys because of my daddy issues.”

In a brand new interview with Howard Stern, Demi, who uses she/they pronouns, reflects on their past relationships and history of dating older men.
youtube_title: Demi Lovato breaks silence on their 'daddy issues'
